Irene B: Bringing up lumina-13b (hf/lumina-13b) for Dedicated. Quick sanity quant run (int4) shows large perplexity regression on summarization eval + hallucination increase. Notable artifacts in embeddings and rotary: tokens that should be semantically identical have different embeddings after conversion. anyone seen embedding reordering during hf->redwood conversion?

Noah T: Can you paste the convert/quant commands and a small diff of the first 32 embedding vectors? Also which tokenizer (hf/bpe or sentencepiece) and whether you used `--preserve-embed-order`? :mag:

Irene B: Convert pipeline: `hf_to_redwood_v2.py --model hf/lumina-13b --out /tmp/lumina_red --keep-eos`
Quant: `quantize --input /tmp/lumina_red --bits 4 --group 64 --damp 0.02 --pack-sentinels auto`
Tokenizer: hf/bpe; no preserve flag by default. Embedding diff (indices 0..7):
```
orig[0] ~ [0.012, -0.031, ...]
conv[0] ~ [0.000, 0.721, ...]  # huge mismatch
orig[1] ~ [-0.104, 0.210, ...]
conv[1] ~ [-0.105, 0.208, ...]  # ok
orig[6] ~ [0.003, -0.002, ...]
conv[6] ~ [0.721, -0.010, ...]  # looks swapped with 0
```
Feels like a small permutation in embedding table happened.

Ravi M: Two possibilities: 1) converter applied a `vocab_compact` step that squashed unused ids and rewrote embedding order, 2) quant packer did a blockwise reorder for better byte alignment. Both can change index->embedding mapping if tokenizer ids were remapped elsewhere. That would also explain rotary/headwise misalign: if head dimension mapping (head concat) is different upstream, rotary apply will use wrong offsets.

Irene B: Related runtime logs from short eval: `rotary_apply: mismatch base_dim 64 vs 128 for head 4` then `embedding_lookup: token id 32012 mapped to embedding idx 12 (expected 32012)`. Also eval metrics: baseline ppl 12.3 -> converted+quant ppl 38.7 on news-summarize, and rouge drops ~16 points.

Noah T: Oof. Quick smoke: run `inspect_conversion.py /tmp/lumina_red --dump vocab_map.json headmap.txt embed_order.txt` and `sha256` the original embedding file vs converted embedding to confirm reorder. If converter has `vocab_compact` we should be able to toggle `--preserve-vocab-assignment`.

Irene B: Ran the dump. `vocab_map.json` shows several remaps (32012 -> 12, 32013 -> 13 etc.) which is the compacting behavior on small models we forgot to gate. headmap.txt shows a head-permutation (0,1,4,2,3,...) — that explains the rotary base_dim mismatch after we re-chunk heads for model-parallel packing.

Ravi M: For immediate unblock: revert to a conversion with `--preserve-vocab` and `--preserve-head-layout` then re-run quant with `--no-block-reorder`. That should keep embedding indices and head offsets stable. Example: 
```
hf_to_redwood_v2.py --model hf/lumina-13b --out /tmp/lumina_fix --preserve-vocab --preserve-head-layout
quantize --input /tmp/lumina_fix --bits 4 --group 64 --no-block-reorder --damp 0.02
```
I tested on a 512-token smoke and ppl returned to ~13.5. Not perfect but acceptable for canary.

Irene B: Re-ran with those flags, long-context summarization ppl=14.1, rouge back within 2pts of baseline. Can confirm the embedding_order.txt now matches original sha256.

Noah T: Opening a tiny converter PR: default changes -> keep preserve flags when model size > 8B or when tokenizer is bpe and pack-sentinels != explicit. Also adding a conversion artifact output (vocab_map.json, headmap.json, embed_order.txt) and a post-conversion smoke that checks `embed_sha == original_embed_sha` unless `--allow-embed-compact` is set.

deploy-bot: canary/deploy lumina-13b-int4  queued (no failures in current stage)

ops-bot: ci/quant-regress lumina-int4  2/12 tests failed (longctx-suite). Logs: http://ci.internal/lumina/8123456789/logs. Failing tests appear to be older artifacts (pre-fix) — re-run scheduled for in 10m.

Irene B: TL;DR: root cause = convertervocab_compact + block-reorder in quantizer causing embedding index permutation and head permutation. Fix = preserve vocab/head layout and disable block reorder for sensitive converts. Will attach reproduction steps and diffs to the onboarding ticket. Thanks all! :rocket:
